areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: Direct link via accessibility features and digital public services for people with disabilities; adequate indicators but modest targets and a very small resource share, so moderate impact.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Credit access for the sector value chain; indicator is not the best fit but feasible; resource share about 30% apportioned; moderate impact, credit is not an innovation.

areas.name: Digital inclusion and connectivity
areas.reason: General objective fully related; three adequate indicators and consistent targets, modest but sound for an initial stage; about one third of resources; moderate impact.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Interactive civic-participation platform is relevant, but the indicator does not measure the area, resources are very small and reach is limited; low impact, though innovative.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Objective and specific objectives are consistent, but no indicator measures the area's impacts and targets are limited to specific cities, so no points.

not_accepted.name: Regional equity
not_accepted.reason: Objective and specific objectives are consistent, but no indicator measures the area's impacts and targets are limited to specific cities, so no points.

bonus.reason: Proponent did not state the programme is exclusively aimed at federal PPA priorities.
Proponent did not state the programme promotes regional integration.
